description: This file contains utility functions for controlling LEDs in an embedded or Linux-based system. It includes functions to get LED device paths, set LED attributes, and control LED blinking patterns and states used for system status indicators.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device tree LED path based on a given LED identifier.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the color function label for an LED based on its device tree node.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Obtains a user-friendly label for an LED, trying to read label, channel name, color, or basename.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets a specified attribute for an LED by writing to sysfs entries.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures an LED to blink with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: led_on
methods.description: Turns the LED on by setting brightness to maximum and trigger to none.

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: Turns the LED off by setting brightness to zero and trigger to none.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for a status LED based on device tree information.

methods.name: status_led_set_timer
methods.description: Sets the status LED to blink with specified on/off durations.

methods.name: status_led_set_heartbeat
methods.description: Sets the status LED trigger to heartbeat mode.

methods.name: status_led_blink_slow
methods.description: Configures the status LED to blink slowly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_fast
methods.description: Configures the status LED to blink quickly.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit
methods.description: Configures the status LED to blink during pre-initialization.

methods.name: status_led_blink_failsafe
methods.description: Configures the status LED for failsafe blinking pattern.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit_regular
methods.description: Sets a regular blinking pattern for pre-initialization.
